notes.key_messages:
The performance on numerical questions improved on that of last year. The use of economic ideas in less
familiar contexts proved to be a stumbling block and would be helped by the use of a wider range of
examples of applied economics.
notes.general_comments:
Five questions, in this case Questions 2, 9, 13, 15, and 28 were at the top end of the facility range and
proved to be easier than intended. The topics that were well known were planned economies, elastic supply,
producer surplus, subsidies and income tax effects. Question 1 proved to be more difficult than the test’s
design specification. Overall, the test gave a clear indication of sound understanding over the breadth of the
syllabus.
